page.notes: Greek passages are transcribed from a small, heavily set print; several Greek words are uncertain and marked [?]. The verse lines and the Greek in the Lucian/Pollux quotations are the least certain. The long s has been rendered as plain s throughout (e.g. "fe" read as "se", "eft" as "est", "fuiffe" as "fuisse").
